paper.title: Algorithm 582: GPS and GK algorithms for bandwidth and profile reduction of sparse symmetric matrices (GPSKCA and related routines)
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 8(2), June 1982, pp. 190-194 (archive header: ALGORITHM 582, ACM-TRANS. MATH. SOFTWARE, VOL. 8, NO. 2, JUN. 1982, P. 190); paper text not checked (artifact-reference claim)

stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 582 GPSKCA and driver, one listing; sample input and output shipped in the same file)

claim.text: GPSKCA on the BCSPWR01 power-network matrix (order 39): BANDWIDTH 6, PROFILE 100, GPSKCA ERROR CODE 0, from the shipped sample output (artifact-reference). Integers, exact tolerance.

attempt: Built the authors' listing without editing a line: lines 1-3762 (algorithms and driver) copied from the archive to gps.f (extraction; recipe cuts it on every run). Output BANDWIDTH 6, PROFILE 100, GPSKCA ERROR CODE 0 match the shipped block exactly.
